answer: An adversary therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 42 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The whisper counter is kept in kernel and spiral reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 42 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Scaling to 567 identities multiplies that fee by 727 with no matching gain in influence. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
